source_text: The resolution recommends that member states enact legislation prohibiting non-therapeutic medical interventions on children, explicitly including "the circumcision of young boys for non-therapeutic reasons" alongside female genital mutilation and non-essential surgeries on intersex children, unless such procedures are deemed medically necessary to safeguard the child's health. [39]
